scalar_cell.name: INTERPOLATING_SCALAR_CELL_V1
scalar_cell.operation: x star_c y = x + y + c*x*y mod N

nilpotent_jet_cell.name: FORMAL_GROUP_JET_CELL_V1
parameters: a true one-dimensional formal group law F over Z/MZ
nilpotent_jet_cell.operation: x star y = J_d(F)(x,y) in I
nilpotent_jet_cell.exactness: All monomials of total degree > d vanish on I, so the d-jet determines the exact finite operation; associativity/unit/formal inverse descend exactly from F.
nilpotent_jet_cell.warning: Naively treating J_d(F) as an ordinary polynomial on an untruncated ring is a different interface and generally creates an associativity defect beginning no earlier than degree d+1.

integer_linearization_boundary.finite_depth_integrality_criterion: For d>=1, both jets through degree d have integer coefficients iff primorial(d)=product_{p prime, p<=d} p divides c.
integer_linearization_boundary.max_integer_safe_depth: D(c)=min{prime p: p does not divide c}-1, with D(0)=infinity.
integer_linearization_boundary.semantic_boundary: Coefficient-integral finite jets are finite linearization data, not a global integer formal logarithm unless all required denominators are legal.

truncation_defect_certificate.general_rule: If H_{d+1} is the first omitted homogeneous layer, then the degree-(d+1) ordinary-polynomial associator of J_d(F) is the negative additive 2-coboundary of H_{d+1}; it may vanish, in which case the first defect occurs later.
